hypotheses.title: Native Fetch Handles Redirects Automatically (Undici/Node.js)
hypotheses.explanation: server.ts line 1620 sets redirect: 'follow' in fetch options. The runtime HTTP engine follows 3xx status codes automatically, but does not intercept each redirect hop to re-verify destination IPs against Gate 4 private IP filters.
supportingSummary: Line 1620 explicitly sets redirect: 'follow'
No custom redirect handler is hooked into fetch options

hypotheses.title: Client-Side Reader Modal Does Not Track Wire Redirects

contradictorySummary: UrlFetchResult schema provides a redirectCount field, suggesting intended reporting
hypotheses.missingEvidence: Verification of whether backend returns finalUrl vs originalUrl

hypotheses.title: Static UrlSecurityEngine Models Redirects in Interface But Does Not Execute

supportingSummary: Interface has redirectCount: number
Engine lacks any node-fetch or http.request execution code
contradictorySummary: Engine is clearly designed for pre-fetch string vetting rather than network execution
hypotheses.missingEvidence: Check if urlSecurityEngine is imported in server.ts
hypotheses.nextRecommendedStep: Inspect server.ts imports to check coupling with urlSecurityEngine.
